body:
Stopped before claiming and marked `blocked`: the 4-axis `G74` / `G75` / `U` `V` / `TP` `TN` G-code format cannot be confirmed cleanly from the available public Sodick sources yet, so writing `G74` output now would risk emitting wrong G-code.

## What was checked

- `RECOMMENDED.md` (#1497, PR #2120) already inspected the 1998 Sodick *Wire EDM Machine Operation* manual (Mark 21 / EX21; `A600` pp. 6-2 to 6-8 and `A320D` pp. 8-12 to 8-14) and recorded:
  - `U` / `V` are described as `"incremental value from the X or Y-axis plane in an absolute mode"` (p. 6-2) and `"U or V axis values are incremental from the X Y values, in absolute from it's present position"` (p. 6-8);
  - the `"absolute"` half of both sentences is not explained, and **no `G74` program example is given**.
- Searches across the 1998 Mark 21 manual (`manualslib.com/manual/2816797`), the 2012 Sodick *Wire EDM Training — LN1W / LN2W Control* manual (`sodick_user_manual_small.pdf`, Ch. 8 pp. 70–73), and Sodick *LPW / LQW / LQW DX / LNW Code Instructions* (`LPW-LQW-LNW-Code.pdf`) confirm:
  - `G74` (`4 Axis On` / `4 Axis Program On X Y U V`) and `G75` (`4 Axis Off` / `4 Axis Program Off`), plus `G140`/`G141`/`G142`;
  - the five height concepts relative to the worktable: `Table to Lower` (`T-Lower`, constant from worktable to lower guide), `Table to Upper` (`T-Upper`, worktable to upper guide), `Table to Limit` (`T-Limit`), `Table to Program` (`TP`, worktable to bottom of part / 1st plane in 4-axis), and `Table to Next` (`TN`, worktable to top of part / 2nd plane in 4-axis).
- Neither manual provides a verbatim worked `G74` NC program example in our retrieved sources (and returned web summaries conflict on `U`/`V` in `G90` vs `G91` and `TP`/`TN` ordering). The sample attached to #617 is another CAM's output and cannot be used under the Clean-Room Protocol.

## Open questions blocking implementation

1. **No manual worked `G74` example**: Done means requires matching "the manual's worked example", which is not present in the read 1998 Mark 21 or 2012 LN1W/LN2W pages.
2. **Unconfirmed `G74` + `G90` + `G40` syntax**:
   - Exact meaning of `U` and `V` under `G74` + `G90` (pure offset from `X`/`Y` on the `TN` plane vs absolute coordinate vs prior-position incremental);
   - Whether standalone `TP` / `TN` words work without `G92` on Mark 21 (`p. 6-3` shows `G92XY TP2.000 TN0000`, while `assets/posts/sodick-wire.cps` emits `G54`–`G59` and no `G92`);
   - Whether a wire-centre `G74` cut uses `G40` or `G140`, and whether `U0. V0.` is required before `G75`.
3. **Waiting on #617 owner confirmation**: Question 12 on #617 explicitly asked the AQ600L owner (`spikeypineapple`) for `U`/`V` semantics and plane heights; their reply states they will answer at `1900 gmt 16/11/26` (ahead of this check).

Note for when this unblocks: `T-Lower` and `T-Upper` / `T-Limit` are machine constants/guide heights, whereas `TP` (worktable to part bottom) and `TN` (worktable to part top) depend on where the workpiece sits above the worktable (`hs.bottom` / `hs.top` relative to the worktable datum).

The facts this issue needs from a Sodick owner (guide and worktable heights; taper as G74/G75 + U V or TP/TN) are now asked in the dry-run kit linked on #1500: https://github.com/mkinney/cam-tools-and-fixtures/tree/main/samples/edm-validation/sodick-kit-2026-11-25
